full_judgment: Bimalendu Bikash Roy Choudhury J: In pursuance of the final decree for partition in Title Suit No.206 of 1990 Kamrunnessa Khatun and Mohibunnessa Khatun (plaintiff-decree holders) filed Title Execution Case Nos. 4 and 5 of 1995 respectively in the Second Court of Subordinate Judge, Sylhet, for khas possession of the detrital lands of their sahams inclusive of the shops standing thereupon. The petitioner who was not a party to the suit or the execution cases raised objections to the delivery of possession to the decree-holders on the ground that he was a tenant in respect of the shops under Haji Abdur Rahman, predecessor-in-interest of the decree-holders and their co-sharers and that he could not be ousted from his possession in course of the execution proceedings. The executing court overruled the objections finding that the petitioner had attorney not to the decree-holders but to some other co-sharer and so he ceased to be a tenant under the decree-holders.
